body.p: After the Phase 0 gate. Owns root CMakeLists.txt, tests/CMakeLists.txt, third_party/CMakeLists.txt. Globs for src/*.c and tests/*_test.c; sxml links sxml_grammar_xml, sxml_grammar_xpath and, when present, sxml_mpdecimal; guarded add_subdirectory for the optional directories (tests/fuzz only with SXML_BUILD_FUZZERS); the CLI's apps line kept. Done when presets pass unchanged and a probe source and test need no edit. Done 2026-10-16: globs in place, probe verified under debug; also added SXML_STATUS_INPUT_OUTPUT_FAILED (, was P1).
